hook.text: London has over 600,000 surveillance cameras. The average Londoner is filmed 300 times per day.

buildup.text: Britain installed CCTV cameras after IRA bombings in the 1990s. They never came down.

discovery.text: Studies found CCTV reduces some crimes in parking lots but barely affects violent crime rates.

twist.text: Despite weak evidence, cameras keep multiplying. The feeling of safety matters more than proof.

climax.text: Britain became the world's most surveilled democracy — and a preview of what cities everywhere become.

quiz.question: What prompted Britain's massive CCTV expansion?
